req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates POST /tasks/ returns HTTP 201 with id, title, completed=false in the body for valid payloads. I design: (1) a positive EP test with a fully valid payload asserting exact status 201 and all response fields; (2) a negative NEG test with a missing required field (title) asserting exact 422 status; (3) a BVA boundary test with title at exactly 1 character (min_length boundary); (4) a BVA boundary test with title at exactly 100 characters (max_length boundary); (5) a DT test with completed explicitly set to true to verify the field is persisted correctly and not hardcoded; (6) a NEG test with title exceeding max_length (101 chars) asserting 422. Together these cover EP, BVA ±1 on string length boundaries, DT for boolean field, and NEG paths, maximising mutation kill rate on status code constants, field presence checks, and boundary comparisons.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title and description
expected: Response body title matches submitted title
trace: R-TASK-001: valid payload -> HTTP 201 + task body
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body():
    payload = {"title": "Test task alpha", "description": "Some description"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 21
    assert body["title"] == "Test task alpha"
    assert body["description"] == "Some description"
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["created_at"] is not None

tests.name: test_create_task_increments_total_task_count
actions: GET /tasks/ again to verify count increased by exactly 1
expected: Total task count after creation equals baseline + 1 (21)
Created task appears in the list with matching id
trace: R-TASK-001: state transition from 20 tasks to 21 tasks
STC: catches mutations that create task but do not persist, or return wrong count
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_increments_total_task_count():
    before_r = client.get("/tasks/", params={"limit": 1000})
    assert before_r.status_code == 200
    before_count = len(before_r.json())
    assert before_count == 20
    payload = {"title": "Count check task", "description": "Verify persistence"}
    post_r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created_id = post_r.json()["id"]
    assert created_id == 21
    after_r = client.get("/tasks/", params={"limit": 1000})
    assert after_r.status_code == 200
    after_list = after_r.json()
    assert len(after_list) == before_count + 1
    assert len(after_list) == 21
    ids_in_list = [t["id"] for t in after_list]
    assert created_id in ids_in_list
